prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic, and no test achieved a statistically significant win.
Split-screen redesigns for adoption persona selection significantly worsened performance.
Adding background processing desktop alert systems significantly worsened performance.
Adding new screens, hints, setup checklists, or wait indicators showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps, layout redesigns, copy updates, and path choice changes showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -2.3% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: -4.7% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +7.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -9.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.3% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -2.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: +3.7% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -9.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, notification: -6.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.0% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -4.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +1.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.7% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Teaser Screen Before Home: Inserts a new desktop interaction teaser screen before home intro showing an animation of the pet walking on desktop. (why: Support mail shows confusion on how to control or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish step drops to 64.8% with high mean time.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Friend Selection Screen: Reorders the onboarding sequence so users pick their friend pet before sign-in. (why: Adoption has low conversion (60.9%) and sign_in takes 567s mean time; picking a pet first increases user investment before sign-in.)
2: [adoption, redesign] List Layout Redesign of Pick Friend Screen: Redesigns the pick friend screen layout into a clean list view with pet traits. (why: Adoption step drops off significantly at 60.9% conversion and 89s median time.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Quick-Start Sound Preview Sub-Flow: Adds a pet audio voice preview screen (new_sound_preview) before completing adoption. (why: Support mails highlight confusion regarding how to talk to pets and post-onboarding feature misbehavior.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Tray Icon Navigation Copy on Home Intro: Updates the home intro text to explain how to reveal and talk to the pet via the system tray icon. (why: Support mails report confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Auto-Sync Safety Hint on Sign-In Screen: Adds a microcopy hint reassuring users that pet choices auto-sync to their account. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Notification Toggle on Waiting Screen: Enables a system desktop notification toggle when waiting so users can minimize the app. (why: Home step has a long mean duration of 2336s and users complain about pet not displaying.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Compact Layout Redesign of Story Screen: Changes story screen layout to compact mode for faster path choosing. (why: choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s and 76.2% conversion.)

scores.note: Adding new screens previously decreased finish step conversion significantly (-9.1%).
Reordering onboarding steps showed no clear positive effect (-1.7%).
Adoption redesigns previously worsened conversion performance by 9.4%.
Adding a new screen in adoption step showed positive lift (+7.2%) despite general new screen risks.
Low-cost copy change directly addresses support mail confusion, though copy updates generally have neutral impact.
Sign-in hints previously had a slight positive lift (+1.5%) and address specific user support emails.
Desktop notification toggles/alerts significantly worsened performance (-6.9%) in prior tests.
Layout redesigns for path selection showed a slightly negative trend (-1.3%).
